messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.6-6 has been released
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

Lavaan 0.6-6 has been released and is now available on CRAN. To install
or update, simply type in R:

install.packages("lavaan")

and restart your R session.

The release notes can be found here:
http://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot6.html

Yves.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan 0.6-6 has been released
parts:
Likewise, semTools 0.5-3 is now available for installation from CRAN.  Relative to the previous version (0.5-2), it includes many bug fixes, new features for existing functions (especially for measEq.syntax objects), and 2 new user-contributed functions.  Please find a more detailed description in our NEWS file.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
